outcome: Overweight and obesity in children at 6 years of age
finding: Maternal obesity and caesarean delivery were strongly associated with childhood overweight and obesity, while breastfeeding duration modified the association between overweight/obesity and other predictors.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with increased risk of overweight/obesity in children at 6 years of age, particularly among those not breastfed or breastfed for less than 12 months.
